title: festuca duriuscula var. rubra
intro: Festuca duriuscula var. rubra, commonly known as Red Fescue, is a perennial grass species belonging to the family Poaceae. It is valued for its potential health benefits, which include reducing inflammation, improving wound healing, and exhibiting antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Red Fescue are attributed to its ability to modulate the immune system, exhibit antioxidant effects, and display anti-inflammatory properties. The bioactive constituents of Red Fescue include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and alkaloids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
